subject: Priority ask: pick one 15m demo window for LumenaTech
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@lumenatech.com>, Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@lumenatech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 09 May 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Priority ask: pick one 15m demo window for LumenaTech

Hi Amit / Sara —

Thanks again for the discovery earlier today. Quick recap + ask so we can lock the next step:

Recap (1-line): LumenaTech is focused on predictable low-latency inference for a multi-tenant analytics pipeline and needs clarity on throughput/quantization tradeoffs and VPC/private deployment options.

Recommended next step: a focused 15–20 minute technical deep-dive + ops Q&A with our infra lead (Ben) and product engineer (Marissa). We'll demo a short run of a representative workload and walk the integration checklist (VPC, KMS, logging).

To avoid back-and-forth given calendar conflicts this week, please pick ONE of these tight windows (all 20-minute slots; we will keep them to 15 min max):
- Fri May 11 — 10:00–10:20 PT
- Fri May 11 — 15:00–15:20 PT
- Sat May 12 — 09:00–09:20 PT

Can you confirm which slot by EOD PT Thu May 10? If we don’t hear back, we’ll release the slots and open the calendar to others (we’re short on dedicated demo windows this sprint).

Attachment: lumena-product-brief.pdf (PDF, 800KB) — very short background we referenced on the call.

If none of these work, reply with two windows you prefer and we’ll do our best to accommodate.

Thanks —
Karthik
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com | (415) 555-0182
From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@lumenatech.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@lumenatech.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 May 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Priority ask: pick one 15m demo window for LumenaTech

Karthik —

Apologies, I ended up double-booked and missed the earlier breakouts. Appreciate the concise recap. 20 minutes sounds fine. Of the three slots you suggested, 10:00 PT on May 11 conflicts with a customer sync on our side. Sara and I can do either 15:00 PT on May 11 or 09:00 PT on May 12.

We'd prefer May 11 15:00 PT if that can be held for us — we’ll confirm final attendee list by EOD Thu. Can you include expected attendees from Redwood and an agenda (very short)? Also confirm whether the session will include a live run or slides only.

Thanks,
Amit
Director, ML Infrastructure | LumenaTech
amit.shah@lumenatech.com | +1 503 555 0123

Date: Thu, 10 May 2028 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Priority ask: pick one 15m demo window for LumenaTech

Hey Amit / Sara —

I’m Ben (infra lead on the session). Quick notes:
- We plan for a LIVE short run of a sample inference job (2–3 reps) — show latency distribution and KV cache behavior.
- Attendees from our side: Ben Carter (infra), Marissa Cole (product engineer), Karthik Iyer (SE).
- Goal: validate integration points (VPC peering options, KMS key flow, audit logs) and confirm next rollout milestone.

I’ve attached a single-slide infra snapshot we’ll reference so you can pre-scan: MAG-Infra-Overview.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB).

One ask from our scheduling team: please confirm the May 11 15:00 PT slot by 4:00 PM PT today (May 10) or we will release it and move it to the public demo queue — we’ve had multiple requests for that window. If May 11 15:00 fails, we’ll tentatively hold May 12 09:00 PT for LumenaTech until EOD as well.

If confirmed, I’ll send a calendar invite with dial-in and a short runbook.

Thanks —
Ben
Principal Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood-inference.com
Attachment: MAG-Infra-Overview.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB)
From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@lumenatech.com>

Date: Sat, 11 May 2028 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Priority ask: pick one 15m demo window for LumenaTech

Ben / Karthik —

Thanks for the context — we’ll take May 11 at 15:00 PT. Please send the calendar invite (include Zoom + dial-in and the short runbook). Attendees from LumenaTech: Amit Shah (me), Sara Lopez (infra lead), plus one product engineer — I’ll confirm the final headcount by Monday.

If you need anything pre-shared (sample payload or a short checklist), reply to this thread and I’ll drop it.

Best,
Amit
